name: @sos-2/api
description: SOS 2.0 Live API (Work Order P2): a plain Node + TypeScript service implementing @sos-2/api-contracts over @sos-2/live-store ports (in-memory reference backend; provider adapters attach later WITHOUT contract change). Route surface: mission / system-state / evidence / task / body-lease / observation reads+writes, event ingestion with replay protection (POST /events), and a health endpoint reporting per-provider availability as typed UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE when unconfigured. The request handler is TRANSPORT-AGNOSTIC (plain ApiRequest -> ApiResponse), so the same contract can later be hosted in Vercel functions or an external worker boundary without change; the node:http binding runs as a plain Node process (repo-standard ESM + tsc build, no vendor framework). No long-running work inside the request lifetime. The only impure boundary is the composition root: the system clock and the port are injected at startup (mirroring the apps/console precedent).
